_comment: With `keepNames`, `export default function () {}` in the root `r.js` gets a `__name()` statement. The finalizer records the place of this statement in the body before the statement `import_c = __toESM(require_c())` moves out of the body, so the move must make the place smaller by one. The function is the last statement: without this change, the place is after the end of the body.
